title: Beat-Built Phrase Into a Glass UI
summary: A centred phrase grows one word at a time, sheds its earlier words, and dives into a glass badge. A floating orb carries the focus into a compact interface reveal.
use_when: a six-to-eight-second feature teaser led by typography
a launch beat that must bridge copy into one compact interface
a light brand with one saturated accent and translucent surfaces

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, 7-12 % of frame height; compact regular UI labels at the close

structure.shot: one centred setup word over a drifting blue-white gradient
structure.motion: word already present; background blobs drift 2-6 px/s with easings.linear over 16 fr

structure.shot: a second word extends the centred setup line and becomes the accent focus
structure.motion: second word blur-in and opacity rise with easings.outExpo 3 fr; line recentres in 10 fr with springs.ui

structure.shot: a third word completes the short setup statement while the middle word stays darkest
structure.motion: third word blur-in with easings.outExpo 3 fr; three-word line recentres over 10 fr with springs.ui

structure.shot: the leading word fades away and the remaining pair shifts back to centre
structure.motion: leading word opacity and blur exit with easings.inExpo 6 fr; reflow rides springs.ui over 10 fr

structure.shot: the second word fades, leaving the final setup word isolated for a brief beat
structure.motion: second word exits with easings.inExpo 9 fr; surviving word recentres with springs.ui

structure.shot: a new two-word reveal statement replaces the isolated setup word
structure.motion: two words crossfade and blur-in sequentially, 6 fr apart, easings.outExpo 6 fr each

structure.shot: a rounded blue badge completes the reveal line with one compact label
structure.motion: glass pill expands with springs.layout; label types across 6 fr with easings.stepped(7)

structure.shot: the complete three-part reveal holds, then the badge fills the frame
structure.camera: zoom-tier full to detail, scale 1.00 to 2.75 in the final 5 fr with springs.cameraSnappy
structure.motion: line holds for 18 fr; camera snap begins at 2.97 s and lands within 5 fr

structure.shot: a translucent orb appears above the enlarged badge while the surrounding phrase crops away
structure.camera: drift x -4 px/s at 1920-wide, scale 1.00 to 0.99 over 39 fr
structure.motion: orb enters over 12 fr with springs.pop, then floats 2-6 px/s with easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: the enlarged phrase and badge dissolve as the glass orb grows and takes focus
structure.motion: type and badge exit with easings.inExpo 11 fr; orb grows with springs.heavy over 11 fr

structure.shot: the glass orb crosses the empty gradient field as the sole subject
structure.motion: orb translates right and down over 11 fr with springs.heavy, retaining its internal refraction

structure.shot: a rounded interface panel slides in and absorbs the orb as its small mark
structure.motion: panel rises and slides left with springs.ui over 13 fr; mark scales down with springs.heavy over 13 fr

structure.shot: the compact interface settles with a mark, heading, two side icons and one highlighted capability row
structure.motion: labels and icons blur-in with easings.outExpo 6 fr and 2 fr stagger; panel holds for 26 fr

structure.shot: the interface fades back into the blue-white gradient
structure.motion: panel, mark and labels exit together with easings.inExpo 9 fr

params.brand: any light brand.json; bg, surface, fg, accent, accent2, display and text fonts drive the whole render
params.content.setupWords: three short words revealed on separate beats, each no longer than 10 letters
params.content.revealWords: two plain words in the replacement phrase
params.content.badgeLabel: one compact label inside the glass badge
params.content.panelTitle: short heading for the final interface, no more than two words
params.content.capabilityLabel: one highlighted interface capability, no more than three words
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); the measured 209-frame structure scales by fps / 30

notes: One continuous shot with zero detected cuts. State boundaries were measured from 30 fps strips; the rapid full-to-detail move occupies about 5 frames. Proposed phrase-chain reflow appends words, removes leading words, and recentres the survivors. The glass orb bridges the badge to the final mark. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured.
